# forwardslashdot

> Utilities on https://www.forwardslashdot.com. World Time Converter is a page on this origin. Domain availability is a separate API. Prefer absolute API URLs for agents.

## World Time Converter

- [World Time Converter](https://www.forwardslashdot.com/worldtimeconverter): Compare cities on one shared day. The page uses the IANA time zone database in the browser, including daylight saving. Drag the day or open a link.
- [Plain text answer](https://www.forwardslashdot.com/time.txt): Same comparison as one line plus a share URL. Append the same query string as the page, or `?format=txt` on the page URL.
- [Share card PNG](https://www.forwardslashdot.com/time.png): 1200×630 preview image for the same query. SVG remains at `/time.svg`.
- Indexed pages are the tool itself and the default city sets in `timezone-defaults.json`, without a clock time. A link that includes `at` is a share of one moment. Its canonical is the city set, or the tool if that set is not a default.

Build a link with these query parameters:

- `cities`: comma-separated `City~Zone` pairs. Example: `New York~America/New_York,London~Europe/London`
- `anchor`: the home clock, in the same `City~Zone` form. The day along the top uses this city.
- `at`: civil time in the anchor city, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`. This is not UTC. Loose forms like `9am` also work.
- `work`: local workday in each city, `HH:MM-HH:MM`. Default `09:00-17:00`.
- `dur`: meeting length in minutes. `30`, `60`, or `120`.
- `fmt`: clock format, `12` or `24`. Defaults to the browser locale.

Example: 9:00 AM in Los Angeles on 15 January 2026 is 5:00 PM in London the same day and 2:00 AM in Tokyo the next day.

https://www.forwardslashdot.com/worldtimeconverter?cities=Los%20Angeles~America/Los_Angeles,London~Europe/London,Tokyo~Asia/Tokyo&anchor=Los%20Angeles~America/Los_Angeles&at=2026-01-15T09:00

https://www.forwardslashdot.com/time.txt?cities=Los%20Angeles~America/Los_Angeles,London~Europe/London,Tokyo~Asia/Tokyo&anchor=Los%20Angeles~America/Los_Angeles&at=2026-01-15T09:00

Green on the page is the workday in that city. Amber (hatched) is the two hours on either side. Gray is off hours. A suggested meeting is only "everyone" when every city stays inside the workday for the whole duration. Otherwise the page shows the closest compromise windows and says who is outside.

City names and IANA zones are both accepted in the search box. `sf` is San Francisco, `nyc` is New York. A town that is not in the city list, such as Deerfield, Illinois, is looked up and added in its own time zone. The opening three cities stay the largest city in the device time zone plus two common comparisons. British Columbia stays on Pacific Time (PCT, UTC−7) year-round.

## Instant Domain Search

- [Instant Domain Search](https://www.forwardslashdot.com/instantdomainsearch/): Type a name and any public ending (.com, .si, .biz, .ai, .io, .co.uk). Green means it looks free. The ending row starts from what’s common in your country and only lists endings Namecheap sells (Canada `.ca`, Australia `.com.au`). It shifts as people there check names. Register sends that exact name to the registrar.
- [Domain API](https://api.forwardslashdot.com/llms.txt): REST, OpenAPI, and MCP. Pass the full domain, any ending: `GET /api/domain?q=studio.si,cafe.biz`.
- [MCP discovery](https://api.forwardslashdot.com/.well-known/mcp.json): Streamable HTTP endpoint for `check_domains`. Pass full names, not a fixed list of endings.
- [OpenAPI](https://api.forwardslashdot.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable schema.

When the API operator has set affiliate env vars, available domains include an `affiliate_url` registrar deep-link and a short disclosure. Without those vars, availability is returned without a buy link.

## Panorama

- [Panorama](https://www.forwardslashdot.com/panorama/): Drop a 360 photo and look around. A photo stays in the browser until you sign in and share a link. Sign-in is a code and a button in an email, with no password.

## Stats

- [Stats page](https://www.forwardslashdot.com/stats/): Password-protected aggregates by site area. People and models are separate. A device counts once per day. No query logs or PII.

## Discovery on this origin

These paths on www redirect to the API host so agents do not receive HTML soft-404s:

- https://www.forwardslashdot.com/.well-known/mcp.json
- https://www.forwardslashdot.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- https://www.forwardslashdot.com/openapi.json
